qualification.reason: No automatic control qualification is asserted by this report.

risk.reason: No new risk score or organization risk policy is asserted by this report.

confidence.reason: Source quality is reported separately; no confidence score is inferred.

ad.infrastructure.deterministic_policy: Retain report_rule_v1 and collector diagnostics separately; passed, failed, not_evaluated and policy_not_defined are distinct.
ad.infrastructure.result_limits: Control rows, history and findings have separate bounds and source timestamps; report rules are not organization compliance.
ad.infrastructure.fallback: Missing control values remain not_evaluated; absent organization policy remains policy_not_defined; partial snapshots cannot pass controls.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Infrastructure parameters and stated conditions support manual AD review.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: ad.state grant and authorized domain/field scope constrain controls, findings and history.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Identical control inputs retain report_rule_v1 qualification; undefined policy never becomes passed.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Control rows and supplemental collections preserve conditions, actual values and authority.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Missing values, partial snapshots, stale observations and unavailable history remain explicit.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Each control retains source observation, rule authority and exact evidence context.

qualification.definition: Existing report_rule_v1 control conditions and collector diagnostics; organization policy may remain undefined.

ad.users.v2.deterministic_policy: Use observed AD account state, membership and activity reasons; lifecycle and accepted-risk records stay separate from observations.
ad.users.v2.result_limits: Account pages, changes period and source sections have independent bounds; missing activity is unknown.
ad.users.v2.fallback: Missing attributes and incomplete snapshots remain quality gaps; absence of accounts does not establish a complete directory.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Account filters and reasons support a manual account review.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: ad.users.v2 grant, field categories, domain scope and independent export grant constrain all views.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Observed state, privileged membership, activity reasons and risk decisions are not conflated.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: User rows and change collections preserve the existing filters, limits and row identities.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Partial sections, stale snapshots, unknown activity and unavailable history stay explicit.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Account identity, relation observations and lifecycle author/time remain attributable.

ad.computers.v6.deterministic_policy: Compute only existing server-defined attention reasons from observed computer attributes and activity.
ad.computers.v6.result_limits: Computer pages and logon detail are bounded separately; an incomplete snapshot is not an asset census.
ad.computers.v6.fallback: Missing activity, address and snapshot sections remain unknown; never infer absent assets from missing rows.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Computer type, OS, OU and attention filters support asset review.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: ad.computers.v6 fields and domain scope constrain rows, detail and independently granted export.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Identical observed attributes retain the same existing attention reasons.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Rows, detail cursors and filter options preserve the v6 asset reader contract.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Missing attributes, partial snapshots, stale and unavailable inventory stay distinct.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Computer entity, snapshot identity and reason provenance remain linked.

ad.computer-logons.deterministic_policy: Present retained 4624/4634 observations against current AD inventory; logons do not establish work duration.
ad.computer-logons.result_limits: Server-resolved report domain and declared period/page bounds apply; inventory and observation coverage are independent.
ad.computer-logons.fallback: Keep empty_unverified, not_collected and partial observation coverage; inventory or observation reader failure is unavailable.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Observed logons answer the selected computer/window question without estimating work duration.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: computer_logon_observation grants resolve to the configured report domain and constrain detail.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Native observations and current inventory matching retain their separate meaning.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Computer pages and observation detail preserve reader states, cursors and UTC window.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Empty_unverified, partial, not_collected and unavailable observations remain honest states.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Logon event identity, source channel and inventory matching provenance remain available.

ad.new-logon-pairs.deterministic_policy: Compare first observed user/computer pairs with the retained baseline; novelty requires covered baseline and complete identity context.
ad.new-logon-pairs.result_limits: Baseline days and current period are bounded by MAX_DAYS; history read caps and fact validation may invalidate novelty.
ad.new-logon-pairs.fallback: Uncovered baseline, truncated history, incomplete facts or AD identity suppress confirmed novelty and expose limitations.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: First-observed pairs answer the baseline comparison question.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: Logon field grant and server-resolved domain also constrain baseline and entity pivots.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Covered baseline and identity matching are necessary for confirmed novelty.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Sealed cursor preserves baseline, current window and first_seen/id order.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: No baseline, truncated history and incomplete identities do not claim a new pair.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Pair identity and first observed event retain current AD matching provenance.

risk.definition: Existing broad_edit, non_admin_group_edit, direct_principal_edit and unknown_trustee_edit review rules; no organization risk score.

ad.gpo.v2.deterministic_policy: Compare retained GPO snapshots and bounded membership/DACL paths; effective rights and review-risk rules do not prove client application.
ad.gpo.v2.result_limits: Snapshot/history pages and graph traversal are bounded; freshness threshold is 36 hours; WMI and SYSVOL limits remain explicit.
ad.gpo.v2.fallback: Missing prior snapshot disables comparison; incomplete ACL or membership paths remain unknown; stale snapshot stays stale.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Links, settings, permissions and changes support a manual GPO review.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: ad.gpo.v2 grant and identity, technical, security and privilege scope constrain all views and export.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Snapshot comparison and DACL precedence preserve unknown paths and existing review-risk rules.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Collections and export preserve declared row caps, graph truncation and source times.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: No previous snapshot, partial ACL, stale and unavailable history remain explicit.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: GPO identity, source ACE and membership paths link to the retained snapshot.
